concerns.text: Task T029 implements 'Topological Complexity Differentiation' (Hurst Exponent) and adds a 'complexity_state' column. This task has no matching FR/SC in the spec. FR-003 explicitly limits metrics to LZC and PE. The plan.md 'Complexity Tracking' section explicitly removed TDA/topological metrics as scope creep. This is a stale/rogue task violating the spec.

Task T025 requires the final report to include 'Topological Complexity Classification' results. This requirement depends on the non-existent T029 and has no basis in the spec (FR-004/FR-006) or plan. The report scope is inflated with unauthorized metrics.

Task T009 (Download) lacks a specific, verified dataset ID or URL in its description or config, making the 'Verified Accuracy' verification step impossible to execute deterministically. FR-001 requires identifying a public dataset, but the task does not specify *which* one, leaving the implementation unanchored to a concrete source.

Tasks T021 (ANCOVA) and T024 (VIF) depend on covariate columns (age, time_of_day, medication_status) that are not guaranteed by FR-001 (which only mandates 'eeg_data' and 'fatigue_rating'). If the chosen dataset lacks these fields, these tasks will fail. There is no task to handle the absence of these optional covariates gracefully or to define a fallback.

Task T023 (Sensitivity Analysis) requires raw p-values from T020, but the dependency chain (T020 -> T023) does not explicitly ensure T023 runs before T022 (BH Correction) or that T020 outputs raw values distinct from corrected ones. If T022 runs first or modifies the source file, T023 will fail or use incorrect data. The execution order is ambiguous.

Task T028 verifies the 6-hour runtime constraint (SC-002) only on the *full pipeline* run. There is no task to verify this constraint during the *development/verification* phase (e.g., on a subset of data) to ensure the limit is not exceeded before the full run is attempted, risking wasted CI time.
